svg.data-dimensions-note: W 438.5 x D 657.5 x H 43.1 mm (datasheet and guide)
svg.data-input-ac: 100 ~ 240 VAC (50-60 Hz) (guide); 100-240 V nominal, 90-264 V max, 47-63 Hz (datasheet)
svg.data-cpu: Intel Hewitt Lake (Xeon D) 4-core or 8-core, 2.9 GHz
svg.data-optics-osfp: up to 20 W transceivers, up to 28 W on ports 1, 2, 31 and 32 (guide); up to 20 W / 26 W (datasheet)
svg.data-timing: IEEE 1588 1-step and 2-step time stamping; transparent and boundary clock; SyncE clock recovery (option)
svg.data-environment: EU RoHS, SVHC requirements of REACH, China RoHS
